name: Mohamed Umar F
title: Software Developer & AI/Cloud Enthusiast
tagline: Crafting Scalable Full-Stack Web & Mobile Applications with Intelligent Cloud Architectures
summary: Aspiring Software Developer with expertise in full-stack application development, AI integration, and cloud technologies. Seeking a challenging Software Developer position to leverage technical skills in Java, Flutter, and cloud platforms while contributing to organizational goals and personal professional growth.

paragraphs: I am a passionate Software Developer and B.Tech graduate in Computer Science and Business Systems from Nehru Institute of Engineering and Technology (CGPA: 7.4).
I specialize in architecting intelligent full-stack applications, mobile solutions with Flutter, and integrating state-of-the-art AI platforms such as Groq API and AWS cloud services.

My hands-on experience spans building real-world AI-powered tools like 'Smart Apply India' for automated job application matching and ATS scoring, as well as enterprise data analysis during my internship at Sunteck.

projects.title: Smart Apply India - AI-Powered Job Application Assistant
projects.description: Developed a full-featured cross-platform mobile and web application with AI-powered job application assistance, automated resume parsing, ATS scoring engine, and keyword compatibility matching.
highlights: Built intelligent resume-to-job-description matching algorithm using keyword extraction and compatibility scoring.
Implemented real-time ATS score analysis and resume parsing functionality with PDF generation via Syncfusion.
Integrated high-speed Groq API with Provider-based reactive architecture for scalable resume optimization workflows.
Enabled secure user authentication and database synchronization through Firebase and Supabase.

projects.title: Enterprise Data Analytics & Insights Engine
projects.description: Data analysis and automated reporting system created during internship at Sunteck, leveraging SQL, Python, Excel, and Power BI for actionable business intelligence.
highlights: Conducted end-to-end data analysis and predictive metric reporting during the internship period.
Built interactive visual dashboards summarizing operational performance indicators.
Automated recurring data transformation routines to reduce manual reporting overhead.

projects.title: Scalable Cloud Architecture & Data Pipeline
projects.description: Designed resilient, scalable cloud architectures and data ingestion pipelines in AWS for high-availability workloads.
highlights: Architected secure VPC, EC2, and S3 integrated data workflows based on AWS Well-Architected Framework.
Implemented relational schemas with MySQL and optimized query response times.

experience.description: Conducted data analysis and reporting during internship period. Extracted key trends from multi-source datasets, created structured summaries for operational teams, and utilized advanced data tooling.
